def chessboard_cell_color(row, col):
    """Determine the color of a single cell on an idealized chessboard whose
    cells alternate between dark and light along both the row and column
    directions. Because the coloring alternates in each direction, the color
    of any given cell is fully determined by a straightforward parity
    calculation performed on its two coordinates. row and col are ints >= 0
    (0-based board coordinates). The calculation yields one of exactly two
    lowercase strings identifying the color of the addressed cell. Return the
    string 'dark' when (row + col) is even and 'light' when (row + col) is
    odd (cell (0,0) is dark).

    >>> chessboard_cell_color(0, 0)
    'dark'
    >>> chessboard_cell_color(0, 1)
    'light'
